decisions.reason: As an adjacent product still shown on its own page in 2024, the compact dumper looks like a low-cost extension of the established range whose option value remains positive.
The articulated construction dumper stays close to the core business and remained actively marketed in 2024, so management would likely keep it while market uptake continues to develop.

Because this mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core range and was downgraded from a dedicated page to only a mention in 2024, its prospects look weaker and the option appears less worth carrying than other opportunities.
A core-adjacent telescopic loader line with several models and a full product page in both years fits the firm's capabilities well and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Despite only being mentioned on the website, the material lift line has explicit evidence of strong demand through a large order and long-standing rental popularity, which strongly supports keeping it.

Although this underground mining loader is more distant from the established offer, the strong early operating result and continued dedicated marketing suggest the option is promising enough to retain.
